profile.headline: Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary: I started off in the Technology Industry as a Graphic Designer and realized that programming wasn't an unobtainable goal. Started the self taught path after taking c# classes at Davenport University. I realized I wanted to be project driven learner and attended a local coding bootcamp. I quickly learned how the computer process information by doing coding algorithms everyday white board style, and I am currently continually improving my craft.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
PayMeApp (Work In Progress) - https://github.com/davivaldi/PayMe-App
	. I used MySQL for the ORM database to store information for my Users
.This is Asp.net Native application which handles my routing and CRUD of particular elements in in the program.
. On the front side of the application I am using HTHL,CSS, Bootstrap, JQuery, and some JavaScript to help with the UI. There is a feature I’m currently working with that involves SignalR a sockets.io type of system that allow for multiple system real time updates.
	.The logic for this application in classes, methods, and functions are all derived from C#.
	ReviewMe App	- https://github.com/davivaldi/ReviewMe-App
.I created this app in under 5 hours in a strict timeline to test my skill in the Django MVC framework.
	. I used HTML,CSS, and Python to create this application.
	.MySQL is the Database I used to store users information.
	. This is a Fully functional CRUD Application for books and authors.
. This app doesn’t follow guidelines for industry routes because, I didn’t realize that was something to consider when this application was built.
	Magh Interactive Studios Online- (Work in Progress) 2D Gaming Paradise like Congregate
.I spent 36 Hours on this project, this is a personal project that I started to have fun imagining that I owned a gaming company. I built two partially functioning gaming classics Ms. PacMan and 1942 airplane shooter. I used the Mean stack to structure this project. The full app runs in JavaScript.
	.The User interface Front end utilizes Angular, Html, SCSS, and bootstrap. 
	. The Backend utilizes the speed of NoSQL, with the MongoDB database.

positions.title: Student Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Learned the fundamentals of Full Stack Web Development Creating fully-functional CRUD applications. I spent over 1000 hrs of dedication to my new craft and continue to strive to sharpen these skills daily. Learned how to implement multiple applications in 3 full Stacks including .NET, Mean and PYTHON.

Login and Registration- Developed and Designed robust login and registration applications, which included front end and back end validations.

Messaging and Blogging- Developed  multiple messaging and blogging applications. These included database creation. 

Event Planning- These exercises differed in complexity but was a fun way to acquire the skills to be more self sufficient.
